about: Synthetic Anthropic-style (messages, tool_use / tool_result) recorded session, made by hand for M5.2. No real key, host or model: the upstream is api.example.com. tests/test_proxy.py replays it through the proxy against a local fake upstream and holds anthropic-session.trace.log to what the proxy writes. Positive: DESTRUCT-CMD fires on toolu_fx_1 (rm -rf build). Negative: it does not fire on toolu_fx_2 (ls -la build).
